about: The alleluia of the formulary “Fourth Sunday after Easter” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: Alleluia, alleluia. The right hand of the Lord has shown strength; the right hand of the Lord has exalted me. Alleluia. Christ, rising from the dead, dies no more; death will no longer have dominion over Him. Alleluia.

a.g: will no longer have dominion over Him
